name: An Dương Vương
role: King of Âu Lạc from 257 BC to 179 BC
contribution: The founding king and the only ruler of the kingdom of Âu Lạc, an ancient state centered in the Red River Delta.

checks.lead: An Dương Vương (Vietnamese: [ʔaːn zɨəŋ vɨəŋ]), personal name Thục Phán, was the founding king and the only ruler of the kingdom of Âu Lạc, an ancient state centered in the Red River Delta. As the leader of the Âu Việt tribes, he defeated the last Hùng king of the state of Văn Lang and united its people – known as the Lạc Việt – with his people, the Âu Việt. An Dương Vương fled and committed suicide after the war with Nanyue forces in 179 BCE.
